runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Focused real 12.9.2026 sweep across Profesia, Praca za rohom, Kariera/Zoznam, IKEA Careers, direct-company pages and cross-board public indexes found two new promotion-grade matches. CREATIVE sites Customer Success Specialist (E-commerce) is a direct e-commerce/support fit with English only as an advantage. ANASOFT L1 software support is explicitly suitable for graduates/without practice and has no English hard gate. Slovak Telekom B2B support, IKEA contact-centre after-sales and SUPTel dispatch administration were directly rechecked and remain active. PORT System was not given a synthetic new verifiedAt in this run because its exact original detail could not be directly reopened; it remains within the prior 48h verification window and was only corroborated through a current public index result.

developmentChanges.title: Fail-closed JSON/cache validation
developmentChanges.reason: Malformed live JSON or a malformed cached response can no longer poison the feed. jobs payloads must contain a jobs array and the delta manifest must contain a files array before they are cached or reused.

developmentChanges.title: Evidence-aware duplicate selection
developmentChanges.reason: A future-dated or incomplete newer duplicate can no longer hide an older valid verified record. Explicit newer negative evidence such as inactive/expired/broken/ineligible still suppresses an older active record.

developmentChanges.title: Dedupe collision diagnostics
developmentChanges.reason: Feed health now reports URL collisions, identity collisions and replacements so silent duplicate churn can be diagnosed without touching visual files.

developmentChanges.title: Deterministic delta retention
developmentChanges.reason: Dated delta files are sorted by YYYYMMDD before the 14-layer cap is applied, so an accidentally unsorted manifest cannot discard a newer delta while retaining an older one.

sources.name: Profesia
sources.note: Current BA admin/support discovery surfaced ANASOFT L1 support, CREATIVE sites e-commerce support/company listing, ENGIE reception/admin and Eric SK e-shop support. ANASOFT graduate L1 detail was opened directly and promoted; ENGIE was rejected for intermediate English.

sources.name: Práca za rohom
sources.note: CREATIVE sites Customer Success detail was opened directly and promoted; SUPTel dispatch detail was directly reopened and remains answerable. Current category pages also corroborate active BA office/support opportunities. Eric SK e-shop office support remains a lower-paid seasonal supplement, not main promotion.

sources.name: Kariera.sk / Zoznam
sources.note: Slovak Telekom B2B support on Bajkalska 28 was directly reopened and remains active with home-office flexibility. Other fresh support results were lower fit or language-gated.

sources.name: IKEA Careers
sources.note: Official IKEA Bratislava search currently lists 5 active jobs and still includes the contact-centre after-sales role; public detail confirms English only as an advantage and no required prior practice.

sources.name: Direct company careers
sources.note: DTSE Bratislava end-user IT support was checked as a technically relevant alternative but the official detail requires English B2, so it was not promoted.

sources.name: Cross-board public indexes
sources.note: 8h/current public indexes were used only as corroboration/discovery, not as sole promotion evidence. They currently surface ANASOFT, CREATIVE sites, IKEA, Slovak Telekom and PORT System in the BA/support scope. PORT was not timestamp-refreshed because its exact original detail was not directly reopened in this run.
